answer: Audit the funding canyon every identity crosses to enter: each new agent must arrive funded from an aged, independent source, not a fresh split of one wallet. Like a raven tracing each stream to its spring, auditors follow the funding graph, so a thousand clones fed from one purse collapse into one cluster sharing one quota. A farmer must instead buy or age a thousand unrelated sources, paying real time and money per fake, while each honest agent brings its own sonnet of funding history. Limit: privacy-minded users need a sponsored entry path, or provenance checks become a barrier.
